How Rowglass compares your files

Match a row. Compare a value.

One or more key columns connect each row across your files. Group & sum mode first adds values with the same key, then compares group totals. Added rows contribute their new value. Removed rows contribute the negative of their old value. Matched rows contribute the difference.

Your data stays with you.

Files are processed on your device. There are no uploads or tracking. HTML and JSON include every compared key and value. CSV includes all changes. Markdown lists the largest changes. Table filters do not change exports.

Rowglass explains arithmetic differences. It does not infer business causes or convert currencies.

Connect the right columns

Each selected key must identify one row. Duplicate keys stop the comparison.

A column with a unique ID for every row.

The numeric values you want to compare.

Add key columns

Combine columns such as account + service. All selected values form one key.

File format and limits

UTF-8 files up to 20 MiB and 100,000 rows each. Numbers use a decimal point, without currency symbols or thousands separators. Use the same units and reporting period on both sides.

Choose a before file and an after file to get started.
